instruction: Use ANSYS in GUI mode to build and solve a 3D solid cantilever beam model. Physical problem: 3D solid cantilever beam under an end concentrated force. Coordinate system and geometry: - Use the global Cartesian coordinate system. - The beam width is along the X direction, the beam height is along the Y direction, and the beam length is along the Z direction. - The beam occupies the following domain: - 0 ≤ X ≤ 10 mm - 0 ≤ Y ≤ 10 mm - 0 ≤ Z ≤ 100 mm - The fixed end is the face at Z = 0. - The free end is the face at Z = 100. - The top midpoint of the free end is the point (X, Y, Z) = (5, 10, 100). Model parameters: - Beam cross section: 10 mm × 10 mm - Beam length: 100 mm - Material: linear elastic steel - Young's modulus E = 210000 MPa - Poisson's ratio ν = 0.3 - Element type: SOLID185 - Mesh: global element size 5 mm Boundary conditions and load: - Fully constrain all translational degrees of freedom on the fixed face Z = 0. - Apply a concentrated force of 100 N in the -Y direction at the free-end top midpoint, i.e. At (X, Y, Z) = (5, 10, 100). Analysis type: - Static structural analysis. Save requirements: - Use C:\Users\user\Desktop as the ANSYS working directory. - Save the database file as: C:\Users\user\Desktop\apdl_solid_beam.db. Save the database file as: C:\Users\user\Desktop\apdl_solid_beam.rst. Run the solver to completion and ensure a result file is generated. You must complete all operations interactively through the ANSYS graphical user interface (GUI) step by step. The use of external script files is strictly prohibited.
